systems.system: State e-procurement systems under the SFTAS programme
systems.country_label: e-procurement systems in the Nigerian States; SaaS electronic government procurement (eGP) suite
systems.platform: software-as-a-service e-procurement suite from a single vendor under a three-year framework agreement led by the Kaduna State Public Procurement Authority
systems.owner: state governments, supported by the World Bank's States Fiscal Transparency, Accountability and Sustainability programme
systems.tiers: states: 16 of 36 had signed on to the framework agreement

note: A World Bank index brief: for Nigeria it covers federal and state systems only (e-procurement, digital identity, state fiscal transparency); local government appears as a general future direction for all countries, with nothing on Nigerian local government offices or their connection.
